_note: Prize per finishing place, index 0 = first. The engine's CSTE scale divides by sum(payouts), so a payoff is invariant to scaling the whole structure: these are written as percent of the prize pool, and entering the same shape in dollars solves to the identical strategy. Every structure here fits a six-seat table (payouts.len() <= stacks.len() is an engine rule) and is non-increasing, which validate() also requires.

presets.label: Winner-take-all
presets.note: One prize. ICM collapses to chip proportion exactly, so this solves to the chipEV strategy, the control case.

presets.label: Top-heavy, 3 paid of 6
presets.note: Half the pool to first. The steepest ladder here, and the one that punishes calling off a covering stack hardest.

presets.label: Standard MTT final table, 6 paid
presets.note: The conventional final-table taper: every seat paid, first worth about nine times last.

presets.label: Flat: 6 paid, near-equal
presets.note: Everyone cashes for nearly the same. Chips are worth nearly what they are worth in a cash game, so play should look closest to chipEV.

presets.label: Satellite, 5 equal seats of 6
presets.note: Five identical seats and one bubble. Chips above the seat threshold are worth nothing, which produces the most extreme bubble factors in the set.
